name: KromiumLoggingConfig
declaration: @ConsistentCopyVisibility data class KromiumLoggingConfig internal constructor(val logSeverity: KromiumLogSeverity)
description: Logging configuration for the Kromium engine. Controls the verbosity of Chromium's internal native logging subsystem.
whenToUse: Configure within KromiumConfig.builder().loggingConfig { ... } to adjust native console logging or completely silence CEF diagnostic messages.

properties.name: logSeverity
properties.description: Log severity level: DEFAULT, VERBOSE, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, FATAL, or DISABLE.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumLoggingConfig.
